blocks.text: Notes in the margin help me remember more of what I read, in week 11 of the plan.
Watering in the evening loses less to the sun than the morning does, in week 11 of the plan.
The long run moves to Saturday so Sunday can be a rest day, in week 11 of the plan.
We will cache the search results for an hour and nobody will notice, in week 11 of the plan.
Reading twenty pages a night gets me through a book a fortnight, in week 11 of the plan.
The tomatoes go in the bed by the fence, where it is warmest, in week 11 of the plan.
